correctness.rationale: The 13-symbol infinite concatenation has three disjoint binary full-shift languages and a directed phase-0/1/2 binary component. For n>=2 unmarked factor count is U_n=6*2^n and unmarked reversal-class count T_n=(9/2)*2^n+(3/2)*2^ceil(n/2). The phase increment +1 mod 3 makes reversals of directed words absent. Separators #^t yield at most 8n^2-7 distinct marked factors; their reflection classes are likewise O(n²). Consequently r_x(n)/C_x(n)->3/4. Unbounded # runs and infinitely many other letters prove not eventually periodic, but the word is not recurrent. Separate finite prefix enumeration for n=2..8 matched both unmarked identities. Exact infinite argument follows language and marker bounds, not finite sampling.
